exposure: vNOTES (Transvaginal Natural Orifice Transluminal Endoscopy) for ovarian cystectomy
surgeon's cumulative experience with vNOTES (phases of the learning curve)
outcome: factors associated with OT (pelvic adhesion, bilateral cyst, max diameter of cyst, individual surgeon)
cohort: 127 patients with various pathological types of ovarian cysts who underwent ovarian vNOTES performed by three surgeons with different levels of endoscopic and transvaginal surgical experience.
finding: The learning curve for ovarian vNOTES was presented in four phases, with operation time significantly shorter in phases II and IV compared to phases I and III, and mastery achieved after performing 7, 9, and 16 cases for surgeons #1, 2, and 3 respectively.
